Patch Notes Oct 12, 2026

🚀 Updates

Save Listings - You can now save listings to look back at later. When on a listing page, click the “save” icon, and view all your saved listings under the Marketplace tab (Note: Only you can see your own saved listings)

View Your Reports - You can now view all your submitted reports/help desk tickets and their current status. You can view this page under the Community tab

WFL - Made updates to the W/F/L calculator page

🐛 Bug Fixes

Fixed filtering by properties on recent trades

Fixed issues with profile badges not updating

Fixed comments duplicating on comps/outfits/etc.

Fixed app notifications not making a sound

Fixed Discord login on app

D2R - fixed issues with Platform property not auto-adding to listings

Dragon Adventures - You can now save up to 2 elements per dragon
